<infobox theme="Battle350">
        <data source="relatedevents"><label>Related events</label></data>
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header></header>	
        <data source="conflict"><label>Conflict</label></data>	
        <data source="proposedby"><label>Proposed by</label></data>
        <data source="date"><label>Date established</label></data>	
        <data source="dissolved"><label>Date dissolved</label></data>
        <data source="terms"><label>Terms</label></data>
    </group>
    <group layout="horizontal" show="incomplete" collapse="open">
        <header>Parties</header>
        <data source="side1"></data>	
        <data source="side2"></data>
        <data source="side3"></data>
    </group>
    <group layout="horizontal" show="incomplete" collapse="open">
        <header>Key individuals</header>
        <data source="ppl1"></data>	
        <data source="ppl2"></data>
        <data source="ppl3"></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Treaty|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox><noinclude>
